description: Dependency updates for the web, the docs and the tools (npm, pnpm catalogs, GitHub Actions); the paused native platforms are left alone.
CONTRIBUTING.md#dependency-updates says how an update pull request is taken in.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for the npm packages' minor and patch updates, pnpm catalog entries and the packageManager field included.

description: lefthook 2.2.2 was published from a maintainer's account, without the trusted publisher and provenance its earlier releases carry, and pnpm's trustPolicy (pnpm-workspace.yaml) refuses it.
Renovate cannot see that policy: offered 2.2.2, it fails to write the lockfile, and the whole npm group is left without one. The next release that pnpm accepts is offered as usual.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for the GitHub Actions, each pinned to a commit SHA with its version in a comment.

description: Playwright waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: the browsers it installs draw the baselines.
The npm packages and Microsoft's image (ci.yml, record-baselines.yml) move together in one pull request, and the baselines are re-recorded in it.

packageRules.description: Microsoft's registry gives no release time, so the image is not held for one; the npm package beside it in the Playwright group is.
Runner images move only on purpose, in ci.yml and record-baselines.yml together, with the baselines re-recorded.
The fonts in a pull request of their own: a font can move the baselines and the docs' glyph list (pnpm generate), and should not hold the other updates back.

@terrazzo/parser is patched (pnpm-workspace.yaml patchedDependencies): a new version needs the patch made again, so it has a pull request of its own and waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

description: The native platforms are paused (packages/tools/paused-platforms.json): no CI job would test an update to them.
Their package managers, React Native's npm packages and what only their CI jobs use stay as they are until each platform's pause ends; the commit that ends it removes the platform here.

packageRules.description: Used only by the paused native CI jobs (Compose, Flutter) (see above).
The JDK and Flutter versions the paused native CI jobs install (see above).
